Pantry updated! ✅ Now, before I lock in tonight's suggestion — just a couple of tiny things:

- 🥩 **The raw meat** — is it chicken or something else? (Helps me plan your wife's veggie alternative)
- 🧄 **Pantry staples** — do you have basics like onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, rice, or soy sauce at home?

But honestly? **You have a brilliant set of ingredients right there!** Here's what I'm already thinking for tonight 👇

---

## 🍽️ Tonight's Dinner Recommendation

### 🌟 Option 1 — **Bhindi Masala (Okra Curry) + Chicken & Prawn Stir Fry** *(~25 mins)*
Perfect because it serves **everyone differently without cooking two full meals!*

| Family Member | Plate |
|---|---|
| 👩 **Wife** | Bhindi Masala (okra) + small portion of potato + Greek yoghurt raita |
| 👤 **You** | Bhindi Masala + grilled chicken (already done! 🎉) + Greek yoghurt — low GI, high protein |
| 👧👧 **Girls** | Grilled chicken + okra + carrots — simple & tasty |

✅ **Low GI** for you — okra is actually fantastic for blood sugar control!
✅ **Vegetarian** for your wife — bhindi masala is a classic
✅ **Quick** — the grilled chicken is already cooked, so dinner is even faster tonight!

---

### 🌟 Option 2 — **Prawn & Okra Stir Fry (Chinese-style)** *(~20 mins)*
- Prawns + okra + carrots stir-fried in butter with garlic & soy sauce
- 👩 Wife gets a **carrot & okra version** with Greek yoghurt on the side
- 👤 You get a high-protein, low GI bowl
- 👧👧 Girls will love the prawns!

---

### 🌟 Option 3 — **Leftover Grilled Chicken Wraps / Rice Bowls** *(~15 mins)*
- Use the grilled chicken as the base, add carrots, okra sauté, and a Greek yoghurt dressing
- Super quick since the chicken is already cooked!

---

### 💡 My top pick for tonight?
**Option 1 — Bhindi Masala + repurposed grilled chicken.** It's fast (chicken's already cooked!), suits everyone's dietary needs, and uses up your most urgent ingredients. The Greek yoghurt makes a perfect raita on the side for all! 🥣

---

Shall I give you a **step-by-step recipe** for Option 1? And do confirm the pantry staples you have so I can make it precise! 😊
